adam.note: Death not recorded in Scripture; end = last genealogical mention (Gen 5:5, age 930). Adam also named in 1Chr 1:1, Lk 3:38, Rom 5:12 (all outside Genesis span).

eve.note: Creation-from-rib at Gen 2:22; last narrative mention as named person ~Gen 4:1 (birth of Cain). Death not recorded; later NT mentions (2Cor 11:3) outside Genesis.

cain.note: First-born Gen 4:1; the Cain line (Enoch/Methushael/Irad/Mehujael) runs Gen 4:17-18. Death not recorded; end = last Genesis genealogy mention Gen 4:25.

abel.note: Appears only in Gen 4; death by Cain recorded at Gen 4:8. Also cited in Mt 10:17, Heb 11:4 (outside Genesis span).

seth.note: Born Gen 4:25; lifespan (912 yrs, death) recorded genealogically at Gen 5:8. Also in 1Chr 1:1, Lk 3:38.

enoch_cain.note: Cain's son, named only in the Cain genealogy Gen 4:17-18; no narrative, no recorded death. Distinct from Seth-line Enoch (Gen 5:18).

lamech_cain.note: Cain-line Lamech; has a short taunt speech Gen 4:23-24. Death not recorded. Distinct from Noah's father Lamech (Gen 5:25-31).

jabal.note: Named only in the Cain-line genealogy Gen 4:20-22 (ancestor of shepherds/tent-dwellers). No narrative, no recorded death.

jubal.note: Named only in the Cain-line genealogy Gen 4:20-22 (ancestor of harp/flute players). No narrative, no recorded death.

tubal_cain.note: Named only once at Gen 4:22 (forger of bronze/iron tools). Single mention only, single verse span.

enoch_seth.note: Seth-line Enoch; genealogy Gen 5:18, lifespan Gen 5:23, 'walked with God' Gen 5:24 (source of tradition). Death not narrated. Also Lk 3:37, Heb 11:5.

methuselah.note: Genealogy Gen 5:21; oldest recorded lifespan (969 yrs) with death at Gen 5:27. Also 1Chr 1:3, Lk 3:37.

lamech_seth.note: Noah's father; genealogy Gen 5:25, sons named Gen 5:28-29, death (777 yrs) at Gen 5:31 (genealogical). Distinct from Cain-line Lamech.

noah.note: Birth Gen 5:29; flood narrative Gen 6-9; death (950 yrs) at Gen 9:29. Also 1Chr 1:4, Lk 3:36, 2Pet 2:5.

shem.note: Born Gen 5:32; sons genealogies Gen 10:21-31; shown age 100 two years after the flood Gen 11:10-11. Death not recorded.

ham.note: Born Gen 5:32; curse narrative Gen 9:18-27; sons genealogies Gen 10:6-20. Death not recorded.

japheth.note: Born Gen 5:32; sons genealogies Gen 10:2-5 only. No narrative, no recorded death.

canaan.note: Ham's son, cursed by Noah Gen 9:25-27; descendants (Sidon, Heth, etc.) Gen 10:15-19. Death not recorded.

nimrod.note: First mighty hunter, kingdom 'began at Babel' Gen 10:8-12. Death not recorded; the project graph's Canaan→Nimrod edge is a ~gap (Genesis places Nimrod as Cush's son, Gen 10:8). Human spot-check recommended.

eber.note: Father of Peleg and Joktan Gen 10:25; lifespan and descendants in the post-diluvian genealogy Gen 11:14-16. NOTE: project graph links Shem→Eber with ~gap; Scripture places Shelah and Arphaxad between (Shem→Arphaxad→Shelah→Eber).

peleg.note: Born when Eber was 34; 'in his day the earth was divided' (Babel-era tradition) Gen 10:25; death (239 yrs) genealogically Gen 11:18-19. Project graph Eber→Peleg matches Scripture.

terah.note: Father of Abram/Nahor/Haran Gen 11:26; travels to Haran Gen 11:31; dies there aged 205 Gen 11:32.

abraham.note: Born (Abram) Gen 11:26; covenant Gen 15/17; death at 175 recorded Gen 25:8. Also 1Chr 1:27, Mt 1:2, Lk 3:34.

sarah.note: Named as Abram's wife Gen 11:29; barrenness Gen 11:30; death in Hebron aged 127 recorded Gen 23:1-2.

hagar.note: Sarai's Egyptian maidservant Gen 16:1; wilderness flight and the well encounter Gen 21:14-21. Death not recorded; hostility order revisited Gen 25:12.

ishmael.note: Birth when Abraham was 86 Gen 16:15-16; descendants Gen 25:12-15; death at 137 recorded Gen 25:17. Also Gen 17:25, Gen 21:20.

lot.note: Leaves Ur with Terah/Abram Gen 11:31; Sodom rescue Gen 19:1-29; last named as ancestor of Moab/Ammon Gen 19:37-38. Death not recorded.

the_fall.note: Spans the Genesis Fall narrative (Serpent→temptation→expulsion). Heavenly (Lucifer) fall is NOT narrated in Genesis — only alluded to (Isa 14:12, Ezk 28:12-16, Lk 10:18); union of both under one span is thematic, not textual. Human spot-check recommended.

the_flood.note: Covers the Flood narrative: ark instructions Gen 6:13-22, deluge Gen 7:10-8:3, recession Gen 8:4-14, Noahic/rainbow covenant Gen 9:9-17. Human spot-check recommended on exact narrative bounds.

babel.note: Tower of Babel narrative Gen 11:1-9: single-language world, city/tower build, divine dispersion, language confusion.
